title: a yodel webhook event (chant.notify/v1)
description: Version 1. The body yodel apply, yodel plan and yodel drift post to the webhook yodel.config.ts notify names: chant's chant.notify/v1 event (https://intentius.io/chant/schemas/notify/v1/notify.schema.json), with source sql-yodeler and the command that sent it in detail.command. Signed with HMAC-SHA256 over '<x-yodel-timestamp>.<body>' in the x-yodel-signature header. A field is only ever added within a version; a receiver ignores fields it does not know.

id.description: The same for every send of one event about one digest (else drift fingerprint, else commit), so a receiver can drop a repeat; random when there is none. The delivery header carries it too.

at.description: When it was sent, ISO 8601 UTC.

project.description: What the run belongs to: the repository, or a name the product gives.

summary.description: One line a person can read.

gate.description: The gate the wave waits on.

environment.description: The environment the run is for.

targets.description: The migrations concerned: the pending ones for apply and plan; empty for drift.

digest.description: The plan digest an approval binds.

approve.description: On waiting: how a person approves it.

command.description: The command to run, as the product prints it.

chant.description: chant's own command for the same approval, when the product's differs.

review.description: Under pr-review: the pull request whose approving review would approve it.

status.description: The command's own word for the outcome: gated, refused, denied, failed, incomplete, drifted.

fingerprint.description: The same drift has the same fingerprint, run after run.

url.description: The CI run's page (GitHub, Forgejo) or job's page (GitLab).

command.description: The yodel command that sent it.
